name: The Shadow Whisperer
source:
It would have been just another uneventful ball, if only you had not piqued the interest of the mysterious Lord Helderon.

[From [url=https://mustjoe.itch.io/shadow-whisperer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
倘若你没有引起那位神秘莫测的赫尔德伦勋爵的兴致，这本该又是一场平淡无奇的舞会。
